content.value_statement: Organizations need consistent controls across the data lifecycle. This skill structures classification, risk assessment, MLPS planning, safeguards, audits, and response deliverables.
actual_capabilities: Classifies core, important, and general data using GB/T 43697-2024 guidance.
Builds important data catalogs and identifies missing evidence.
Structures risk assessments for leakage, unauthorized access, tampering, loss, and supply chain threats.
Designs lifecycle controls for access, encryption, masking, logging, sharing, and disposal.
Drafts MLPS, DSMM, audit, incident response, and security assurance deliverables.
limitations: Recommendations depend on accurate system, data, industry, and jurisdiction details.
The skill does not replace qualified assessors, regulators, legal counsel, or licensed institutions.
It cannot perform live scans, deploy controls, or verify evidence without supplied artifacts.
Its standards guidance focuses primarily on the Chinese regulatory context.

use_cases.title: Classify Enterprise Data
use_cases.description: Create a classification table and important data catalog from an inventory, ownership details, scale, sensitivity, and business impact.

use_cases.title: Plan Security Remediation
use_cases.description: Map lifecycle gaps to access, encryption, masking, logging, backup, disposal, and incident response controls.

use_cases.title: Prepare Assurance Evidence
use_cases.description: Draft evidence checklists and report structures for MLPS assessment, financing review, registration, audit, or DSMM improvement.

prompt_templates.title: Classify a Data Inventory
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify these assets as core, important, or general under GB/T 43697-2024. State assumptions, evidence gaps, and controls: [asset list].

prompt_templates.title: Review Lifecycle Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess controls across collection, storage, use, sharing, transfer, and disposal. Prioritize gaps by threat, vulnerability, impact, owner, and deadline.

prompt_templates.title: Build an MLPS Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this system for MLPS scope and likely level. Provide rationale, filing steps, remediation work, evidence needs, timing, and external dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Assurance Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an integrated security program for [organization]. Include classification, risk register, lifecycle controls, DSMM roadmap, audit schedule, incident response, and evidence.

output_examples.input: Classify customer profiles, public product data, and high-value transaction records.
output: Customer profiles: general sensitive data, internal level 3, with encryption and controlled access.
Public product data: general public data, internal level 1, with integrity controls.
High-value transaction records: assess industry thresholds before deciding important status; apply level 4 controls meanwhile.

output_examples.input: Outline a security assurance package for a financing review.
output: Management evidence: approved policies, ownership records, training logs, and risk acceptance decisions.
Technical evidence: access reviews, encryption design, masking rules, immutable audit logs, backup tests, and vulnerability remediation.
Assurance evidence: MLPS filing, assessment reports, incident exercises, audit results, and tracked corrective actions.

best_practices: Provide current inventories, architecture diagrams, control evidence, and applicable industry requirements.
Separate confirmed facts, assumptions, evidence gaps, and recommendations in every deliverable.
Validate classifications and compliance conclusions with accountable owners and qualified external assessors.
anti_patterns: Do not assign important data status solely from a generic example.
Do not treat encryption as sufficient without access control, key management, logging, and recovery.
Do not present draft guidance as regulator approval or a completed independent assessment.

faq.question: Can this skill determine whether data is important data?
faq.answer: It can structure the assessment and compare supplied facts with applicable catalogs. Final classification requires industry context and accountable review.

faq.question: Does it perform an MLPS assessment?
faq.answer: It prepares scope, likely level, gaps, evidence, and remediation plans. A qualified assessment body must perform formal testing.

faq.question: Can it create an important data catalog?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the inventory, business purpose, scale, precision, affected parties, geography, and industry requirements.

faq.question: Which lifecycle stages does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers collection, storage, use, sharing, transfer, and disposal, including controls and audit evidence.

faq.question: Can it recommend encryption and masking controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose control requirements, but implementation choices require architecture, threat, performance, and legal details.

faq.question: Is the guidance limited to China?
faq.answer: The knowledge base centers on Chinese laws and standards. Supply other jurisdictional requirements before applying it elsewhere.
